limitations: 0.5M small model, CPU, fp32 activations/KV/embeddings/tied head; weight-only. Dequantize on every Linear, then fp32 matmul: no native integer MAC acceleration. No accuracy acceptance threshold. Implementation passed does not mean acceptable accuracy. Decode uses a fixed fp32 teacher-forced continuation and immutable prefill cache, no rollover; full decoding includes K/V concatenations. Components replay captured actual Linear inputs; dequantize and matmul+bias are separately measured probes, not additive causal attribution. Persistent payload ledger excludes Python metadata and transient buffers; tied head counted once. All comparison models and probe buffers coexist; tracemalloc peaks are incremental, miss native allocations; RSS is process lifetime high-water mark, neither proves model compression. Counterbalanced single-process orders, no confidence intervals. T4 floor is a historical heuristic.
